value.rationale: The short step, long step, and statistical-advantage parameter are the defining tuning coordinates of the practical ASGD design. The theorem shows exactly how the statistical parameter changes the permissible short-step margin: it can either enlarge or shrink the ordinary SGD interval, with a sharp transition at ten sevenths. The uniform lower envelope also explains why the source curvature-scaled short-step regime remains stable even though the long step can be individually expansive.
